table.title: Table
table.description: The source table to extract into this row's output table

options.tooltip: Click "Load Tables" to fetch the list of tables from your tenant. Requires the connection fields (environment, tenant, username, password) in the parent configuration to be filled in first.

load_type.title: Load Type
load_type.description: How this row's table is written to Storage

options.tooltip: **Full Load** (default) overwrites the output table every run. **Incremental Load** upserts by primary key instead, but it never removes rows that were deleted upstream — this source keeps no change history to detect deletions from. If this run's primary-key uniqueness check fails for this table, the run automatically falls back to Full Load for that run only and logs a warning; it does not fail the job.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Row cap for the first fetch call on this table

options.tooltip: This API has no page-continuation token, so this is not a literal page size — it is the row cap sent on the *first* fetch call for this table. Tables at or under this count finish in that single call. A larger table triggers one further, final call sized to its actual row count plus a small safety margin, and no more calls are made after that. Raise this only for an unusually large table, to avoid the two-call path.
